recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD61 免疫染色中，大量棕色陽性細胞密集散佈，從大型巨核細胞到許多小型單核的陽性細胞（小巨核細胞或巨核母細胞）都有，並伴隨陽性碎片，顯示巨核細胞系明顯增生。
features: Numerous CD61-positive cells diffusely distributed throughout the marrow
Wide size range: occasional large megakaryocytes and many small mononuclear positive cells
Small positive cells likely represent micromegakaryocytes and megakaryoblasts
Abundant CD61-positive cytoplasmic fragments and platelet debris
Background CD61-negative hematopoietic cells with blue hematoxylin counterstain
describe_en: CD61 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow trephine highlights a marked increase in megakaryocytic lineage cells distributed throughout the marrow. Positive cells range from occasional large megakaryocytes to many small mononuclear forms, consistent with micromegakaryocytes and megakaryoblasts, with abundant positive cytoplasmic fragments. The stain confirms megakaryocytic lineage expansion, which in a child with Down syndrome supports myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (acute megakaryoblastic type).

ddx.vs: TAM shares CD61-positive megakaryoblasts and GATA1 mutation but presents in the neonatal period and often regresses.
Reactive hyperplasia consists of mature, normally sized megakaryocytes without numerous small mononuclear CD61-positive blasts.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Cohesive tumor cells in neuroblastoma are CD61 negative, while megakaryoblasts express CD61/CD41.
